lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to explain how one character can send a message that starts another character’s script, and plan a relay.
The orange envelope block sends a message — like passing a note.
The yellow “start on message” block waits for that message, then runs.
A red message only starts scripts waiting for red.
Rabbit runs, then sends a message.
Turtle gets it and runs next.
The rabbit runs to the turtle (star) and says “Your turn!” — that’s the message.
Message passed — now the turtle can go!
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
